newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary extends deadline of sugar factory tender.
newsitem.headline: Hungary extends deadline of sugar factory tender.

text.p: Hungary's state privatisation agency APV Rt has extended the tender deadline of sugar company Kabai Cukorgyar Rt's privatisation to November 6 from October 9, APV spokesman Adam Dudits said.
"In APV's opinion the potential bidders needed this extension to make a correct bid," Dudits told APV's weekly news conference. APV's rules allow this extension, he added.
APV offered a 40 percent stake or a nominal 1.78 billion forints of the sugar factory's 4.45 billion forint share capital, he said.
Kabai's majority shareholder, the British-French consortium of Eastern Sugar which holds a 60 percent stake has a preemption right to buy the stake on offer.
Dudits declined to give a precise figure, but said that around three investors showed interest in buying the stake.
He also said Kabai sugar factory has a 14 percent stake on the Hungarian market.
